{{Quote|Purple, hooded monster. Carries a lantern.|Description}}
The '''Masterberry''' in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'' is a purple variation of the [[Tonberry (Tactics Advance)|Tonberry]]. It is even more vicious than its green cousin, mainly because of its high Speed and devastating Voodoo attack.
